scripts.transpile: npx tsc && npx tsc -p ./components/introspection.nodes && npx tsc -p ./components/introspection.edges
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.features: npx cucumber-js --tags 'not @samples and not @shutdown' && TOA_INTROSPECTION_SAMPLES=1 npx cucumber-js --tags @samples && TOA_INTROSPECTION_INTERVAL=3600 npx cucumber-js --tags @shutdown
